question: In which state is Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the **Adilabad district** of Telangana.
 
• The sanctuary spans an area of approximately **893 square kilometers**.
 
• It was declared a wildlife sanctuary in **1965** to protect its rich biodiversity and wildlife.
 
• Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary is known for its population of **tigers, leopards, and deer**.
 
• In 2012, it was designated as a **Tiger Reserve** under Project Tiger to ensure better conservation efforts for the tiger population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Project Tiger**

 
 
• It is a tiger conservation program launched in India in **1973**.
 
• The aim is to protect tigers from extinction by ensuring a viable population in their natural habitats.
 
• Project Tiger focuses on habitat preservation, anti-poaching measures, and scientific management.
 
• India has over **50 tiger reserves** under this project, covering various regions across the country.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity Hotspot**
 
 
• A biodiversity hotspot is a biogeographic region with a significant reservoir of biodiversity that is under threat from humans.
 
• To qualify as a biodiversity hotspot, a region must contain at least **1,500 species of vascular plants** as endemics.
 
• It must have lost at least **70% of its original habitat**.
 
• The Eastern Himalayas and Western Ghats in India are examples of biodiversity hotspots.
 
 
 
• **Wildlife Sanctuary**
 
 
• A wildlife sanctuary is a protected area reserved for the conservation of wild animals and their habitats.
 
• Human activities such as cultivation, grazing, and forestry are regulated to ensure minimal disturbance to wildlife.
 
• India has over **500 wildlife sanctuaries**, each focusing on preserving different species and ecosystems.
 
• Examples include Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary, Jim Corbett National Park, and Kaziranga National Park.
 
 
 
• **Ecotourism**
 
 
• Ecotourism is a form of sustainable travel that supports the conservation of natural environments.
 
• It aims to minimize the negative impact on the environment and local communities.
 
• Ecotourism promotes responsible travel practices, environmental education, and cultural awareness.
 
• Popular ecotourism destinations in India include Periyar National Park, Sunderbans, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
